statement: ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s (f-g) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (f-g) ≤ KdVPlan.hn s f + KdVPlan.hn s g ∧ |KdVPlan.hn s f-KdVPlan.hn s g| ≤ KdVPlan.hn s (f-g)
proof:
intro s f g hf hg
rcases (h_T013.1 s f).mp hf with ⟨x, rfl⟩
rcases (h_T013.1 s g).mp hg with ⟨y, rfl⟩
have he : KdVPlan.FromLP s x - KdVPlan.FromLP s y = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x-y) := by
  funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, mul_sub]
constructor
· exact (h_T013.1 s _).mpr ⟨x-y, he⟩
rw [he, h_T013.2.1 s (x-y), h_T013.2.1 s x, h_T013.2.1 s y]
exact ⟨norm_sub_le x y, abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y⟩
